children: Overview
Canada industrial REIT's Q3 property revenue rose 15% yr/yr on portfolio growth and higher rents
Q3 net operating income up 17.5% yr/yr, FFO rose 36%
Company completed acquisition of four Winnipeg industrial properties and improved AFFO payout ratio
Outlook
Company expects further cash flow growth in Q4 as renewed leases contribute for a full quarter
Company says government investments in defense, energy and infrastructure expected to support demand
PROREIT targets C$2 bln in assets and 45% Adjusted Debt to Gross Book Value in 3-5 yrs
Result Drivers
PORTFOLIO EXPANSION - Revenue and NOI growth mainly driven by increased number of properties, including recent acquisitions
RENTAL GROWTH - Higher contractual rents and positive spreads on lease renewals and new leases supported income growth
AFFO PAYOUT RATIO IMPROVEMENT - Lower payout ratio quarter-over-quarter due to full quarter contribution from recent acquisitions and rental growth
